name: Prime Oil Chemical Service Corporation
summary: Prime Oil Chemical Service Corporation engages in the petrochemical shore tank storage services in Taiwan. It is also involved in the building and operation of photovoltaic power generation systems with a total installed capacity of 24.31MW. In addition, the company engages in the chemicals, oil tank storage and transportation services, general trade, solar power generation business, and commercial real estate leasing business activities. It serves petrochemical manufacturers and traders. Prime Oil Chemical Service Corporation was founded in 1978 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.
